findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_resume" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ats_changes · Private data: get_agent_resume · Public sink: ats_stats, ats_changes · Destructive: check_resume, get_agent_resume.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ats_changes · Private data: get_agent_resume · Public sink: ats_stats, ats_changes · Destructive: check_resume, get_agent_resume

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
